message: Due to issues with DeepSeek or intentional behavior, file uploading is currently unavailable in Expert mode.
DeepSeek removed Web Search from Expert Mode. We are working to bring it back. You can test the developer build from our GitHub repository.
Ran out of ideas for what the extension should do next? If you have a suggestion, please share it on GitHub.
FYI, you may have seen on social media that a new version of DeepSeek V4 Flash has been released. This new version is currently API-only; the web version still has the old V4 Flash active. -BDS
DeepSeek V4 Pro has been released! You can now try it in Expert mode. Upgraded V4 models are now active on the web interface.

An update released today by DeepSeek has broken Better DeepSeek, whether intentionally or unintentionally. We have released an urgent fix. It may take up to 24 hours for the update to be reviewed and published by the extension stores. Thank you for your understanding. -BDS

If this update was intentionally released by the DeepSeek team to discontinue Better DeepSeek, please feel free to contact me via GitHub or a similar platform. I am open to discussion and will respectfully comply if removal is requested. -BDS

Due to a recent update to the DeepSeek interface, some extension features may currently not be working properly. We are aware of the issue and actively working on a fix. For more details or if you would like to help resolve it, please check our GitHub repository. -BDS

Better DeepSeek just passed 512 stars on GitHub and unlocked the Silver Starstruck achievement. Back when it hit 128 stars, I thought 512 was impossible. Genuinely didn't think we'd get here. Thank you to everyone who starred, tested, reported, and contributed.
